patterns.note: Full-width sections with predominantly dark backgrounds, centering content within a consistent maximum width for readability.
Primary headings use a very large, bold sans-serif typeface for strong impact, contrasted with smaller, lighter body text and occasional uppercase labels for feature categories.
A deep, dark blue (#161e33) serves as the dominant background, providing a canvas for white text and vibrant accent colors like a bright pink/red for calls-to-action and subtle blue/purple gradients.
The hero section features a background image that scrolls at a slower rate than the foreground content, creating a subtle parallax depth effect as the user scrolls down.
Feature and integration sections are frequently presented as grids of cards, each with an icon, title, and brief description, set against the dark background.

technique_notes: A fixed header navigation bar remains visible at the top of the viewport, providing persistent access to site navigation.
The hero section utilizes a background image layer that moves at a different speed than the foreground content, creating a sense of depth and visual interest during initial scrolling.
Main content sections are introduced with a subtle slide-up and fade-in animation as they enter the viewport, gently revealing new information.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, bold headings (~4-5x body text) establish a strong hierarchy, complemented by smaller, legible body text and occasional uppercase labels for emphasis.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (buttons, cards, and input fields feature a slight, consistent corner rounding).
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and a more compact grid for feature cards.

standout: The site's distinctive dark, cosmic aesthetic, featuring astronauts and celestial bodies, sets it apart from typical enterprise tech sites. This visual theme is consistently applied, creating a memorable and sophisticated brand identity that evokes exploration and advanced technology.
